ratios.quote: The Credit Agreement requires the Company to maintain (i) a Senior Secured Net Leverage Ratio not exceeding 3.00 to 1.00 (subject to a step-up to 3.50 to 1.00 following the completion of certain permitted acquisitions) and (ii) a Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of at least 2.00 to 1.00 , each tested quarterly commencing with the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026.

The Credit Agreement requires the Company to maintain (i) a Senior Secured Net Leverage Ratio not exceeding 3.00 to 1.00 (subject to a step-up to 3.50 to 1.00 following the completion of certain permitted acquisitions) and (ii) a Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of at least 2.00 to 1.00 , each tested quarterly commencing with the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026.

parsed.notes: The filing does not disclose actual ratio values. It only states that the Company was in compliance with all financial covenants as of 2026-09-30. The leverage limit can step up to 3.50x after certain permitted acquisitions. Covenant testing begins with the quarter ending 2026-09-30. The Senior Secured Net Leverage Ratio is also used to set the interest margin and the unused commitment fee; those pricing uses are not included as covenants.
